name: Vincit
source:
"I don't really know where I am going. Neither do I know where I want to go. In this case it’s impossible to go in the wrong direction."

The story is about a friendship between two characters convalescent.
[From [url=https://nighten.itch.io/vincit] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“我真的不知道自己要去哪里，也不知道自己想去哪里。在这种情况下，不可能走错方向。”

这个故事讲述了两个康复中的人物之间的友谊。
[来自[url=https://nighten.itch.io/vincit] itch.io[/url]]
